alts: Seven things a plumber’s site has to get right. The person calling is standing in an inch of water with about ninety seconds of patience. Swipe through.
01. The number at the top. In the header of every page, as a link that dials when tapped. 02. The hours, stated. Say when you answer, so the person at 11pm knows whether to call.

03. The towns, by name. Baytown, Highlands, Mont Belvieu. People search the place they live, not a metro area. 04. A page per job. Water heater, slab leak, repipe. Each is a different search and a different person.
05. Your own photos. Two pictures on every job, one before and one after. 06. Real reviews. With a first name and a town. “Satisfied Customer” reads like you typed it.
07. Fast on one bar. Fast enough to open on cell data in a metal-sided garage, on a phone at four percent. The number has to be tappable before the page finishes loading.
